newsitem.title: UK: Go-Ahead up on positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: Go-Ahead up on positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in Go-Ahead Group Plc rose on Monday after upbeat comment on the stock in the Sunday Times, dealers said.
Go-Ahead shares were up 10p at 437-1/2 by 0813 GMT in thin trade of 8,504 shares.
Shares in the bus operator had on Friday closed at near their lowest level of the year -- down from its peak of 534p set in mid March.
The Sunday Times "inside track" column said the stock looked tempting at its lower levels, especially given an expected government drive to wean more people onto public transport.
It said the stock was on a prospective price-earnings multiple of just ten times, with profits expected to rise to 31 million stg in the year ended June 1997.
The paper said there were possible improvements in profit margins to come and opportunities for expansion in continental Europe.
